messages:
Maya: Quick proposal  10-day sprint: pricing page experiment + short webinar. Scope: FAQ refresh, two slab-name variants, and a guided cost calculator. Goal = lift qualified leads.

Carlos: 👍 Can we gate the calculatorfirst-week results behind an email opt-in and A/B test names in the hero?

Eden: For calculator outputs, let's show: monthly estimate, recommended config (batching/quant), and suggested plan. Capture team_size and use-case.

Tess: Sales asks: map calculator_submit -> HubSpot. Rule: monthly_estimate >= 1500 -> SDR assign; else -> nurture. I'll share mapping.

salesbot: test event: calculator_submit fired 9 times (staging).

Maya: Draft routing (please review):
```yaml
event: calculator_submit
fields: [monthly_estimate, team_size, email, use_case]
rules:
  - if: monthly_estimate >= 1500
    action: assign_sdr_pricing
  - if: team_size >= 5
    action: notify_enterprise_team
  - else
    action: add_to_nurture
```

Carlos: Slab name options: Option X = Core / Growth / Enterprise; Option Y = Dev / Scale / Reserved. Prefer X for clarity. We'll A/B test across 50/50 traffic.

Eden: Webinar blurb draft: "How to pick the right Redwood plan and cut inference costs". Keep cost claims conservative, include benchmark slide. Loop legal.

Tess: Timeline: finalize names Tue, hero variants Wed, HubSpot mapping Thu, webinar Fri. I'll validate webhooks in sandbox.

Maya: Metrics to track: calculator_start, calculator_submit, faq_cta_click, sdr_assigned. Tag with experiment=pricing-slab-2026.

Carlos: I'll prepare hero copy variants. Eden, can you prep laser slide comparing per-1k token cost across configs?

Eden: Yep. Will include methodology notes.

Maya: Great work. I'll make the calendar invite and doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/EXAMPLE-PRICING-SPRINT. Reconvene after first-day data. :rocket:
